    BrickAccessibility.exists_positive_coordinate

    Lemma 4.6: a positive endpoint coordinate #

    For a nonsimple brick string module M(w) over a representation-finite gentle algebra, some vertex v satisfies dim Ext¹(M, S_v) < dim Hom(S_v, M) or dim Ext¹(S_v, M) < dim Hom(M, S_v).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.exists_positive_coordinate {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [IsAlgClosed k] [FiniteDimensional k B] (D : MonomialData k B) (hD : D.IsGentle) (hrep : IsRepFinite B) (w : Word D.Q) (hw : Word.IsString D w) (hb : IsBrick B (Word.stringModule D w hw)) (hns : ¬IsSimpleModule B (Word.stringModule D w hw)) :
    ∃ (v : D.Q.V), Module.finrank k ↥(Ext1 k B (Word.stringModule D w hw) (D.simple v)) < Module.finrank k (D.simple v →ₗ[B] Word.stringModule D w hw) ∨ Module.finrank k ↥(Ext1 k B (D.simple v) (Word.stringModule D w hw)) < Module.finrank k (Word.stringModule D w hw →ₗ[B] D.simple v)

    Lemma 4.6, combined with the bounds of Lemma 4.3.
